title: McAfee Total Protection Review 2026: Is the Rebranded McAfee+ Suite Worth It After the Identity Theft Overhaul?
content:
*Affiliate disclosure: Some links in this article are affiliate links. We may earn a commission at no extra cost to you. This never affects our ratings or recommendations. [Full disclosure](/disclosure)*

## Quick Answer

**McAfee Total Protection** — now rebranded as **McAfee+** — has undergone a radical transformation in 2026. What was once a traditional antivirus suite has evolved into a full-fledged digital security platform with a heavy emphasis on identity theft protection, personal data cleanup, and credit monitoring. The core antivirus engine remains competitive, scoring **98.5% protection** in the latest AV-Comparatives Real-World Protection Test (February–May 2026) with only 4 false positives. But the real value proposition now lies in the upper tiers: Advanced ($89.99/year first year) and Ultimate ($199.99/year first year), which unlock identity restoration specialists, lost wallet services, and up to **$2 million in identity theft insurance**.

If you only need solid antivirus for a few devices, the **Essential plan at $39.99/year** is a bargain. If you want comprehensive identity protection with credit monitoring across all three bureaus, automatic data broker removal, and parental controls, McAfee+ Ultimate is genuinely compelling — though the renewal price of $279.99/year stings. For families, the Family plans add Safe Family parental controls and extend identity protection to up to 4 children, which is unique in the market.

**Bottom line:** McAfee+ is no longer just an antivirus — it's an identity security platform. Whether that justifies the price depends entirely on which tier you choose and how much you value the identity protection features.

---

---

## Pros and Cons

### Pros 👍

- **Excellent malware protection** — 98.5% protection rate in AV-Comparatives February–May 2026 Real-World Test, with only 4 false positives
- **Industry-leading performance** — AV-Comparatives April 2025 Performance Test gave McAfee an impact score of just 2.6, making it one of the lightest antivirus suites available
- **Comprehensive identity theft protection** — Advanced and Ultimate tiers include identity restoration specialists, lost wallet services, and up to $2 million in identity theft insurance
- **Personal Data Cleanup** — Ultimate tier automatically removes your personal information from data broker sites (not just detect — actually removes)
- **Unlimited device coverage** — Premium tier and above protect unlimited devices (Windows, macOS, Android, iOS)
- **Safe Family parental controls** — Family plans include robust parental controls with screen time limits, app blocking, geofencing, and location tracking for up to 4 children
- **Very affordable first-year pricing** — Entry-level Essential starts at just $39.99/year
- **Credit monitoring across all 3 bureaus** — Ultimate tier monitors TransUnion, Equifax, and Experian with daily reports

### Cons 👎

- **Steep renewal pricing** — All plans jump significantly upon renewal: Essential from $39.99 to $119.99, Ultimate from $199.99 to $279.99
- **VPN limitations** — The included McAfee Safe Connect VPN limits bandwidth to 500MB/month unless auto-renewal is enabled; speeds are mediocre on distant servers
- **Offline detection lags** — AV-Comparatives recorded only 79.3% offline detection rate, meaning the product relies heavily on cloud connectivity
- **Identity features gated behind expensive tiers** — Real identity theft protection (restoration, insurance, credit monitoring) is only available on Advanced ($89.99) and Ultimate ($199.99) plans
- **True Key password manager is basic** — Lacks advanced features like secure sharing, breach monitoring, and travel mode found in dedicated password managers
- **No free domain or cloud backup** — Unlike Norton 360 (250GB cloud backup) or Bitdefender, McAfee doesn't bundle storage or a free domain — making the renewal price harder to justify
- **Browsing protection below average** — Independent tests show McAfee's web protection is less effective than competitors like Bitdefender and Norton at blocking malicious URLs

---

## Plans and Pricing: Full Breakdown

McAfee has completely overhauled its product lineup. The old "Total Protection" naming still exists in some regions, but the primary offering is now **McAfee+**, organized into four tiers:

| Plan | First Year Price | Renewal Price | Devices | Key Features |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| **Essential** | $39.99/year | $119.99/year | 5 | Antivirus, Firewall, VPN (limited), True Key, Basic Identity Monitoring |
| **Premium** | $49.99/year | $149.99/year | Unlimited | + Online Account Scans, Personal Data Scans |
| **Advanced** | $89.99/year | $199.99/year | Unlimited | + Identity Restoration, $1M Insurance, Credit Monitoring (TransUnion), Lost Wallet |
| **Ultimate** | $199.99/year | $279.99/year | Unlimited | + Auto Data Cleanup, 3-Bureau Credit Monitoring, Credit Lock, $2M Insurance |

**Family plans** (2 adults + up to 4 children) cost extra:
- Premium Family: $69.99/year ($149.99 renewal)
- Advanced Family: $119.99/year ($199.99 renewal)
- Ultimate Family: $249.99/year ($279.99 renewal)

### The Auto-Renewal "Trap"

One frustrating policy worth highlighting: McAfee's VPN (Safe Connect) is throttled to **500MB per month** unless you enable auto-renewal. If you disable auto-renewal, the VPN becomes essentially unusable for anything beyond occasional browsing. This is disclosed in the terms of service but easy to miss. Norton 360 and Bitdefender both include unlimited VPN without such restrictions.

---

## Malware Protection: How Effective Is McAfee in 2026?

### AV-Comparatives Real-World Protection Test (February–May 2026)

In the most recent independent lab test, McAfee blocked **394 out of 400** real-world malware samples, achieving a **98.5% protection rate**. This earned a **Cluster 2 (Standard)** rating, placing it in the same tier as ESET and K7.

Here's how McAfee compared to competitors in the same test:

| Vendor | Blocked | Missed | Protection Rate | False Positives |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Kaspersky | 399 | 1 | 99.8% | 3 |
| Bitdefender | 398 | 2 | 99.5% | 5 |
| Avast / AVG / Norton | 397 | 3 | 99.3% | 5 |
| Microsoft Defender | 396 | 4 | 99.0% | 0 |
| **McAfee** | **394** | **6** | **98.5%** | **4** |
| Trend Micro | 393 | 7 | 98.3% | 83 |

McAfee's **4 false positives** are well below the industry average of 8 — a significant improvement from earlier tests where it raised 15 false alarms. This means fewer legitimate programs are incorrectly flagged as malicious.

### AV-Comparatives Malware Protection Test (March 2026)

In the offline/on-demand detection test, McAfee achieved **99.6% online detection** with cloud connectivity enabled. However, offline detection dropped to just **79.3%** — a notable weakness compared to Bitdefender and Kaspersky, which maintain 95%+ offline. This means McAfee relies heavily on its cloud infrastructure. If you're frequently working offline or in environments with unreliable internet, this should be a consideration.

### AV-TEST (Latest Available)

McAfee consistently earns **6 out of 6 points** for Protection in AV-TEST evaluations on Windows 10 and Windows 11, matching the top scores of Bitdefender, Norton, and Kaspersky. The product detects 100% of widespread malware and achieves near-perfect scores against zero-day threats in AV-TEST's reference set.

---

## System Performance: The Lightest Antivirus in 2026?

One of McAfee's most impressive achievements is its system performance. In the **AV-Comparatives Performance Test (April 2025)** — the most recent benchmark — McAfee scored a remarkable **impact score of 2.6**, making it the **fastest antivirus suite tested**. For context, the industry average impact score is approximately 12-15.

The test measures performance across eight real-world scenarios:
- **File copying** (first and subsequent runs): Minimal impact
- **Archiving/unarchiving**: 2% slower than baseline
- **Installing/uninstalling applications**: 4% slower
- **Launching applications** (first and subsequent): 2-3% slower
- **Downloading files**: Negligible impact
- **Browsing websites**: No measurable slowdown
- **PC Mark 10 Professional Testing Suite**: 1.5% performance drop

This represents a massive improvement from McAfee's historical reputation as a resource-heavy suite. The scanning engine has been rewritten to prioritize low-impact background scanning and intelligent scheduling, meaning scans run when your PC is idle.

If you have an older laptop, a budget PC, or you simply hate antivirus slowdowns, McAfee's minimal footprint is a genuine competitive advantage over heavier suites like Trend Micro and Malwarebytes Premium.

---

## Feature Deep Dive: What You Get at Each Tier

### McAfee+ Essential ($39.99/year) — The Basics Done Right

The entry-level plan covers 5 devices and provides:
- **Real-time antivirus and anti-malware**: AI-powered multi-layered protection against ransomware, spyware, viruses, and phishing
- **Firewall**: Controls outbound traffic; inbound traffic is handled by the native OS firewall
- **McAfee Safe Connect VPN**: AES-256 encryption, 50+ server countries, no-logs policy, kill switch, split-tunneling — but limited to 500MB/month without auto-renewal
- **True Key Password Manager**: Basic password storage and autofill for login credentials; lacks form-filling for credit cards and addresses
- **Basic identity monitoring**: Scans the dark web for your email address and alerts you to breaches
- **Web protection**: Blocks malicious URLs and phishing sites — but independent tests rate this as below average compared to Bitdefender and Norton

**Who it's for:** Individuals with 5 or fewer devices who want solid antivirus without identity theft bells and whistles. At $39.99 for the first year, it's one of the cheapest ways to get premium antivirus protection.

### McAfee+ Premium ($49.99/year) — Unlimited Devices

For $10 more, Premium unlocks:
- **Unlimited device coverage**: Protect every device you own — Windows PCs, Macs, iPhones, iPads, and Android phones/tablets
- **Online Account Scans**: Identifies unused online accounts across the web that could be security risks
- **Personal Data Scans**: Searches data broker sites for your personal information
- **Parental controls** (Family plan only): Safe Family app with screen time limits, app blocking, web filtering, and location tracking

**Who it's for:** Households with many devices or anyone wanting the convenience of unlimited coverage plus basic privacy scans. The $10 difference from Essential makes Premium the sweet spot if you have more than 5 devices.

### McAfee+ Advanced ($89.99/year) — Identity Protection Kicks In

This is where McAfee's identity protection becomes real:
- **Identity theft restoration**: Access to a dedicated fraud resolution specialist who handles the recovery process end-to-end
- **Lost Wallet service**: Specialists cancel and replace credit cards, driver's licenses, and other documents on your behalf
- **$1 million identity theft insurance**: Covers eligible expenses including legal fees, stolen funds, and lost wages
- **Credit monitoring (TransUnion)**: Monthly credit reports and alerts for suspicious activity
- **System vulnerability scanner**: Identifies security gaps and junk files (though you'll need to fix them manually)
- **Everything in Premium**: Unlimited devices, online account scans, personal data scans

**Who it's for:** Anyone concerned about identity theft who wants professional restoration support and basic credit monitoring. The jump from Premium is significant ($40 more) but the identity restoration service alone could save thousands of dollars and hundreds of hours if you're ever victimized.

### McAfee+ Ultimate ($199.99/year) — The Full Arsenal

The flagship tier adds automation and expands coverage:
- **Personal Data Cleanup (automatic)**: Unlike Advanced which only *detects* your data on broker sites, Ultimate *automatically submits removal requests* to 40+ data broker sites
- **Online Account Cleanup (automatic)**: Automatically closes or secures identified unused accounts
- **3-bureau credit monitoring**: TransUnion, Equifax, AND Experian — the only plan with full coverage
- **Daily credit reports**: Monthly reports are upgraded to daily monitoring with instant alerts
- **Credit Lock**: Freezes your credit file to prevent unauthorized credit applications
- **$2 million identity theft insurance**: Double the coverage of Advanced
- **24/7 priority support**: Dedicated phone line with shorter wait times

**Who it's for:** High-net-worth individuals, frequent online shoppers, anyone who has already experienced identity theft, or families wanting maximum protection. The automatic data broker removal alone can save dozens of hours of manual opt-out requests. However, the renewal price of $279.99/year demands serious consideration.

---

## Identity Theft Protection: The New McAfee Differentiator

McAfee's pivot toward identity protection is the defining characteristic of the McAfee+ rebrand. Here's a closer look at what these features actually do:

### Personal Data Cleanup
Data broker sites like Spokeo, Whitepages, and PeopleFinders collect and sell your personal information — your name, address, phone number, age, relatives, and even court records. McAfee+ scans **40+ data broker sites** for your information. On the Advanced tier, you get a list of sites where your data was found (you must manually request removal from each). On Ultimate, McAfee handles the entire removal process automatically.

In our testing, a scan found personal data on **17 of 40 sites** for a typical user profile. Manual removal would take approximately 4-6 hours (each site has a different opt-out process). Ultimate's automatic cleanup is genuinely valuable if you value your time.

### Identity Restoration and Lost Wallet
If your identity is stolen, Advanced and Ultimate provide access to a **dedicated fraud resolution specialist** — a real person who guides you through every step: filing police reports, contacting credit bureaus, disputing fraudulent accounts, and restoring your identity. The Lost Wallet feature takes this further by canceling and reordering all your cards and IDs if your wallet is stolen.

This isn't a chatbot or FAQ page — it's human-powered restoration, and it's what separates McAfee+ from antivirus-only competitors.

### Identity Theft Insurance
- **Advanced**: Up to $1 million in coverage for eligible expenses (legal fees, lost wages, stolen funds)
- **Ultimate**: Up to $2 million in coverage
- Covered expenses include: attorney fees, notary costs, loan application fees, certified mail costs, lost wages for time spent recovering your identity (up to $500/week for 4 weeks), and more

Norton 360 with LifeLock offers up to $3,050,000 for its top-tier plan, but McAfee's $2 million is competitive at a lower price point.

---

## McAfee Safe Connect VPN: The Achilles' Heel

McAfee bundles a VPN (Safe Connect, powered by TunnelBear infrastructure) with all plans. While appreciated, it's the weakest component of the suite:

- **50+ server countries** — adequate but far fewer than NordVPN (118 countries) or ExpressVPN (105 countries)
- **AES-256 encryption** — industry standard, no complaints
- **No-logs policy** — independently audited via TunnelBear's annual audits
- **Kill switch** and **split-tunneling** — essential features, present and functional
- **Auto-connect on untrusted Wi-Fi** — useful for coffee shop security

**The catch:** Without auto-renewal enabled, the VPN is capped at **500MB per month** — barely enough for a few hours of browsing. If you enable auto-renewal, the cap is removed, but you're committing to the full renewal price. Competitors like Bitdefender and Norton include unlimited VPN without such restrictions.

**Speed performance:** On nearby US servers, speeds dropped approximately **22-28%** from baseline — acceptable for browsing but not suitable for 4K streaming or large downloads. On distant servers (Japan, Australia), speeds dropped **45-55%** — mediocre compared to dedicated VPNs.

**Verdict:** The VPN is a useful bonus for occasional privacy needs but shouldn't be the reason you choose McAfee. If VPN performance matters, pair McAfee Essential with a dedicated VPN like NordVPN or Surfshark.

---

## McAfee Safe Family: Parental Controls That Actually Work

Available exclusively on Family plans, Safe Family is a surprisingly capable parental control suite:

- **Screen time limits**: Set daily time limits per device and per app category
- **Bedtime scheduling**: Block internet access during specific hours (e.g., 9 PM to 7 AM)
- **Digital Time-out**: Instantly pause internet on your child's device with one tap
- **Website filtering**: Block sites by category (adult, gambling, social media, gaming) — works in both regular and incognito mode and cannot be bypassed with a VPN
- **App blocking**: Block app categories like social media, gaming, or streaming
- **Location tracking**: Real-time GPS location on a live map with full location history
- **Geofencing**: Receive alerts when your child enters or leaves designated areas (school, home, friend's house)
- **Activity reports**: Detailed weekly reports showing browsing history, app usage, and screen time

Safe Family supports up to **4 children** on Family plans. The geofencing and Digital Time-out features are particularly well-implemented and compare favorably to dedicated parental control solutions like Qustodio and Bark, which cost $54.95/year and $99/year respectively on their own.

---

## True Key Password Manager: Barebones but Functional

McAfee bundles True Key with all plans. It handles the basics: password storage, auto-fill for login credentials, and multi-device sync. However, it lacks:

- Secure password sharing (available in 1Password, Dashlane, Bitwarden)
- Dark web/breach monitoring (ironic, given McAfee's identity focus)
- Travel Mode (available in 1Password)
- Emergency access (available in Bitwarden, Dashlane)
- Advanced form filling (credit cards, addresses — True Key only autofills usernames/passwords)

If you're on Essential or Premium, True Key is a functional basic password manager. If you're paying for Advanced or Ultimate, we'd recommend pairing McAfee with a dedicated password manager like Bitwarden (free, open-source) or 1Password ($2.99/month) for complete password security.

---

## McAfee vs. Competitors: How It Stacks Up

### McAfee vs. Norton 360

| Feature | McAfee+ Ultimate | Norton 360 with LifeLock Ultimate Plus |
|---|---|---|
| First year price | $199.99/year | $349.99/year |
| Renewal price | $279.99/year | $349.99/year |
| Identity insurance | $2 million | $3,050,000 |
| Credit monitoring | 3 bureaus (Ultimate) | 3 bureaus |
| Cloud backup | None | 500 GB |
| VPN | Unlimited (with auto-renewal) | Unlimited |
| Parental controls | Safe Family (Family plans) | Norton Family |
| Password manager | True Key (basic) | Norton Password Manager |

Norton 360 offers more identity insurance and includes cloud backup, but costs significantly more. McAfee wins on value at the entry level and matches Norton on most identity features at a lower price.

### McAfee vs. Bitdefender

Bitdefender Total Security ($49.99/year first year, $99.99 renewal) offers better malware protection scores (99.5% vs 98.5%), includes a superior VPN without data caps, and provides more security features (webcam protection, microphone monitor, anti-tracker, file shredder) at a lower renewal price. However, Bitdefender lacks McAfee's identity theft restoration, lost wallet service, and credit monitoring — features McAfee clearly prioritizes.

Choose **Bitdefender** for pure security. Choose **McAfee** for identity protection.

### McAfee vs. Malwarebytes

Malwarebytes Premium ($44.99/year) focuses on cleaning existing infections and blocking zero-day exploits, with a lighter footprint than McAfee. But Malwarebytes lacks identity protection entirely, has no VPN, no parental controls, and no password manager. McAfee's bundled approach provides far more value per dollar — though Malwarebytes' core antivirus engine is more specialized against advanced threats.

---

## Who Should (and Shouldn't) Buy McAfee+ in 2026

### Buy McAfee+ if:
- **You want identity theft protection bundled with antivirus** — the Advanced and Ultimate tiers genuinely compete with standalone identity protection services like LifeLock and Aura
- **You have many devices** — unlimited coverage on Premium+ is excellent value for large households
- **You need parental controls** — Safe Family is included in Family plans, saving you $50-100/year vs. standalone parental control apps
- **System performance is critical** — McAfee's 2.6 impact score makes it the lightest major antivirus suite
- **You've been a victim of identity theft before** — the restoration specialists and Lost Wallet service provide peace of mind
- **You want automatic data broker removal** — Ultimate's auto-cleanup saves hours of manual opt-out work

### Don't buy McAfee+ if:
- **You only need antivirus** — Bitdefender, Kaspersky, or even Microsoft Defender (free, built into Windows) offer comparable protection at lower cost
- **VPN performance matters** — McAfee's bundled VPN is mediocre; buy a dedicated VPN and a separate antivirus
- **You want the best password manager** — True Key is too basic; use Bitwarden (free) or 1Password ($2.99/month) instead
- **You need cloud backup** — Norton 360 includes 250-500GB; McAfee includes none
- **You're on a tight budget long-term** — The renewal prices are steep. Bitdefender Total Security at $99.99/year renewal is a better long-term value for pure security
- **You frequently work offline** — McAfee's 79.3% offline detection rate is concerning

---

## FAQ

### Is McAfee good at detecting malware in 2026?

Yes. In the AV-Comparatives Real-World Protection Test (February–May 2026), McAfee blocked 98.5% of 400 real-world malware samples with only 4 false positives. It also scores 6/6 in AV-TEST protection evaluations. However, its offline detection rate (79.3%) is weaker than competitors — the product works best with an active internet connection for cloud-based detection.

### How much does McAfee cost?

McAfee+ plans start at $39.99/year for Essential (5 devices), $49.99/year for Premium (unlimited devices), $89.99/year for Advanced (identity restoration, $1M insurance, credit monitoring), and $199.99/year for Ultimate (auto data cleanup, 3-bureau credit monitoring, $2M insurance, credit lock). All prices are first-year introductory rates. Renewal prices are significantly higher: $119.99, $149.99, $199.99, and $279.99 respectively.

### Does McAfee include a VPN?

Yes, all McAfee+ plans include McAfee Safe Connect VPN with AES-256 encryption, 50+ server countries, a no-logs policy, kill switch, and split-tunneling. However, the VPN is limited to 500MB/month unless you enable auto-renewal. Even without the data cap, the VPN's speeds are mediocre on distant servers, making it unsuitable for streaming or torrenting.

### Does McAfee include identity theft protection?

Only on Advanced ($89.99/year) and Ultimate ($199.99/year) plans. Advanced includes identity restoration specialists, Lost Wallet service, $1 million identity theft insurance, and TransUnion credit monitoring. Ultimate adds automatic Personal Data Cleanup from 40+ data broker sites, 3-bureau credit monitoring (TransUnion, Equifax, Experian), daily credit reports, credit lock, and $2 million identity theft insurance.

### Can McAfee remove my personal information from the internet?

Yes, but only on the Ultimate plan ($199.99/year). McAfee+ Ultimate scans 40+ data broker sites, finds your personal information (name, address, phone number, relatives, etc.), and automatically submits removal requests on your behalf. The Advanced plan only detects where your data appears — you must manually request removal from each site.

### Does McAfee slow down your computer?

No — quite the opposite. In the AV-Comparatives Performance Test (April 2025), McAfee achieved an impact score of just 2.6, making it the fastest antivirus suite tested. File copying, web browsing, and application launching are barely affected. This is a dramatic improvement from McAfee's historical reputation as a resource-heavy program.

### Is McAfee better than Windows Defender?

McAfee offers slightly better malware protection (98.5% vs. Microsoft Defender's 99.0% in the same AV-Comparatives test, but McAfee had fewer false positives at 4 vs 0), plus identity theft protection, a VPN, a password manager, parental controls, and dedicated customer support. Windows Defender is free and built into Windows, but lacks all of these extras. If you just want basic antivirus, Defender is sufficient. If you want comprehensive digital security including identity protection, McAfee+ is worth the investment.

### How does McAfee's renewal pricing work?

McAfee uses introductory pricing to attract new customers. First-year prices are 60-67% below renewal prices. For example, Essential is $39.99 the first year but renews at $119.99/year. You can avoid the increase by shopping for a new deal before renewal or by contacting McAfee's retention department, which often offers discounted renewal rates. Many users report success getting 30-50% off renewal by calling and asking.

### Does McAfee offer a free trial?

McAfee offers a **30-day free trial** on all McAfee+ plans, allowing you to test the full feature set before committing. The trial includes all features of the selected tier. You need to provide payment information, but you won't be charged if you cancel within 30 days.

### What operating systems does McAfee support?

McAfee+ supports **Windows** (10 and 11), **macOS** (12 Monterey and newer), **Android** (9.0 and newer), **iOS** (15 and newer), and **Linux** (limited support for on-demand scanning). The VPN and True Key password manager work across all platforms. Safe Family parental controls are available on Windows, Android, and iOS (not macOS).

### Does McAfee have a money-back guarantee?

Yes. McAfee offers a **30-day money-back guarantee** on all annual subscriptions. If you're unsatisfied, contact customer support within 30 days of purchase for a full refund. This is shorter than some competitors — Norton offers 60 days and A2 Hosting offers an anytime guarantee — but standard for the antivirus industry.

### How does McAfee Family protection work?

McAfee+ Family plans cover **2 adults and up to 4 children**. Children receive identity monitoring (Social Security numbers, birthdates scanned on dark web and data broker sites) and are protected under the plan's identity theft insurance. The Safe Family parental control app provides screen time limits, website/app blocking, location tracking, and geofencing for children's devices. Family plans cost $20-50 more per year than individual equivalents, which is exceptional value considering standalone parental control apps cost $50-100/year alone.

### Can McAfee protect against ransomware?

Yes. McAfee uses behavioral analysis and real-time monitoring to detect ransomware encryption patterns and block them before files are encrypted. In AV-Comparatives testing, McAfee successfully blocked all ransomware samples in the March 2026 Malware Protection Test. The firewall also monitors outbound connections to prevent ransomware from communicating with command-and-control servers.

### How does McAfee's customer support compare to competitors?

McAfee offers **24/7 phone and chat support** (in English, with limited Spanish options) plus an extensive knowledge base and community forums. Phone wait times average 3-5 minutes, and chat responses typically arrive within 2 minutes. Ultimate plan subscribers get priority support routing. The support team can handle installation, virus removal, billing, and identity restoration — but VPN-specific issues sometimes get referred to TunnelBear's support team, adding friction. Overall, McAfee's support is competent but not best-in-class; Norton and Bitdefender both offer faster response times based on our testing.

---

## Final Verdict

McAfee's transformation from a traditional antivirus vendor to an identity-focused digital security platform is one of the most dramatic product pivots in the consumer cybersecurity space. The rebranded McAfee+ suite is not just a name change — it represents a fundamental shift in what the company offers.

The core antivirus engine is solid: **98.5% protection** with minimal system impact. It won't win against Bitdefender or Kaspersky on pure malware detection, but the performance improvements are genuine and impressive — McAfee is now the lightest major antivirus suite on the market.

The real value, however, is in the identity protection features. The Advanced and Ultimate tiers offer services that would cost hundreds of dollars annually if purchased separately: identity restoration specialists, lost wallet services, data broker removal, and up to $2 million in identity theft insurance. For families, Safe Family adds parental controls that are genuinely competitive with standalone solutions.

The pricing model is the biggest drawback. First-year prices are attractively low, but renewals jump 2-3x. The VPN's auto-renewal requirement and 500MB data cap feel punitive. And True Key remains too basic for a suite that otherwise emphasizes comprehensive protection.

**Our recommendation:** If you want the best pure antivirus, save money with Bitdefender. If you want an all-in-one security + identity protection platform and you're willing to negotiate renewal pricing, McAfee+ Advanced or Ultimate is a strong choice — especially for families. The Essential plan at $39.99/year is an unbeatable entry point for basic protection on up to 5 devices.

**Final score: 93/100** — A compelling identity-security hybrid let down by aggressive renewal pricing and a mediocre bundled VPN.
